answer_1.quote: We evaluate the ability of models to produce explanations.

answer_2.quote: We explore several methods to evaluate different aspects of model-generated explanations: ROUGE-L , BERTScore , BLEURT , two variants of BARTScore-BARTScore+ and BARTScore++ , three metrics of CTC (Deng et al., 2021)-Consistency, Relevance, and Preservation, and three metrics of G-Eval (Liu et al., 2023a)-Coherence, Consistency, and Relevance.

answer_3.quote: G-Eval utilizes an LLM (e.g., GPT-4) as the backbone model to score the quality of model-generated explanations in different aspects.
methods: G-Eval framework with CoT and form-filling

answer_4.quote: We recruit crowdworkers with a Master's or Doctorate degree in Medicine/Healthcare through Prolific to evaluate 30 randomly sampled examples from Medbullets-5, along with their explanations generated by GPT-4 and PaLM 2 under XY * →R prompting.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to evaluate completeness, correctness, and relevance.
